Tapu feels guilty for suggesting the competition and breaks down, begging doctors to see his mother. Jethalal, Champaklal, and the rest of the Gokuldham members are deeply anxious, awaiting doctor reports while hoping for her recovery.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
